`deploy.yml` tests and deploys the Worker (`pnpm run deploy`) on every push to `main`, and can be run manually from the Actions tab. It needs repository secrets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` (Workers Scripts edit, plus R2 and Workers Routes access for this account) and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`. Optional repository variables `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_TOKEN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIXPANEL_API_HOST`, and `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION` are inlined into the build. Worker runtime secrets stay in Cloudflare (`--keep-vars`).

Comic publishing stays local: `pnpm comic:publish -- --slug <slug>` uploads and verifies new media, signs the R2 catalogue update, and verifies public reader surfaces without a Worker deployment. `scripts/deploy_latest.sh` is a compatibility wrapper for the same command.
